subject: Security onboarding: SOC 2 / pen-test report / vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@neurolytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Security onboarding: SOC 2 / pen-test report / vendor questionnaire

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so your security team can evaluate Redwood for the Neurolytics pilot:

- Ask recap from the call: SOC 2 report availability, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire (your standard XLS), and pen test report access (redacted vs full).
- What we can share now: our latest SOC 2 Type II summary (we’ll attach the SOC 2 summary and a redacted pen test), plus a short write-up of our vulnerability management SLAs and scanning cadence.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll loop in Rishi (heads up: he’s copied) to provide technical details and our preferred redaction rules for pentest reports.
2) Please send your vendor questionnaire (XLS) to this thread and the security team contact you want us to use.
3) We’ll attach a redacted pen test (limited to exec summary + findings) and our vuln process doc for initial review; if you need the full report we can set up an NDA/SSPA.

Timing: we can get the redacted pen test + vuln process doc to you by EOD tomorrow. If that works, please confirm and share the questionnaire.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: (will attach redacted_pentest_2025.pdf, vuln_process_overview.pdf when we follow up)

From: Emma Chen <emma@neurolytics.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2 / pen-test report / vendor questionnaire

Hi Lauren — thanks, that timeline sounds good. A couple clarifying items from our side before we start completing the questionnaire:

- SOC 2: we typically ask to review the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just the summary) for vendors storing protected health data. Will Redwood provide the full report under an SSPA/NDA?
- Pen test: we prefer a redacted PDF for initial review. If possible, include CVSS scores for each finding and remediation status (open/closed/mitigated).
- Vulnerability SLA: we need target remediation windows by severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low) and a public disclosure policy.
- Scanning cadence: please confirm if you run internal weekly scans and quarterly external pentests, and whether you have continuous monitoring on prod.

I’m attaching our vendor security questionnaire (VSA_export_2026.xlsx). Please have your security team fill in the technical sections (encryption, key management, access controls, data residency). We’ll also need a single security contact and an estimated time to deliver the redacted pen test.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Head of Security, Neurolytics
security@neurolytics.io

Attachment: VSA_export_2026.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@neurolytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2 / pen-test report / vendor questionnaire

Emma — appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Rishi from our InfoSec team to respond to the technical portions. Attached to this message you’ll find: vendor_questionnaire_neurolytics.xlsx (pre-filled where appropriate), redacted_pentest_2025.pdf (exec summary + findings with CVSS), and vuln_process_overview.pdf (SLA table + cadence).

Quick answers to your bullets so you have a snapshot while Rishi reviews: 
- SOC 2: we can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under our standard SSPA; we typically redline the customer name and any third-party attachments. If Neurolytics needs the full report earlier, I can start the SSPA exchange.
- Pen test: attached redacted PDF includes CVSS and current remediation status. For full report access we require an NDA or SSPA (security practice).
- SLA (high level): Critical — initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, target remediation or mitigations within 7 days; High — ack 48 hours, remediation target 30 days; Medium/Low — standard 90-day remediation window. See vuln_process_overview.pdf for the table and escalation path.
- Scanning cadence: we run automated internal scans weekly, external authenticated scans monthly, and third-party external penetration tests annually (we can support an accelerated pentest on request). Continuous monitoring via IDS/agent-based signals is enabled in prod.

Proposed timeline: if you confirm the SSPA/NDA requirement for full SOC 2/pen test access, we’ll start that process today. Otherwise, the attachments should be enough for an initial security evaluation.

Related links: HubSpot deal NB-7832 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NB-7832)

Best,
Lauren

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_neurolytics.xlsx, redacted_pentest_2025.pdf, vuln_process_overview.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@neurolytics.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2 / pen-test report / vendor questionnaire

Hi Emma — thanks for the questions; a few technical clarifications from InfoSec: 

1) Pen test access: we provide a redacted report by default (exec summary, findings with CVSS, remediation status, and proof-of-fix where applicable). Full pen tests require an SSPA/NDA and a signed data processing addendum if PHI is in scope.

2) Vulnerability classification & SLA detail (excerpt):
   - Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): acknowledgement within 24 hours; mitigation or compensating control in 7 calendar days; emergency hotfixes prio.
   - High (7.0 - 8.9): acknowledgement within 48 hours; remediation plan in 14 days; target closure 30 days.
   - Medium/Low: acknowledgement 5 business days; remediation tracked and closed within 90 days unless otherwise agreed.

3) Scanning cadence & monitoring:
   - Internal authenticated scans: weekly (sprint aligned, automated scheduling).
   - External authenticated vulnerability scans: monthly.
   - Continuous runtime monitoring: agents + IDS signatures; alerts routed to on-call and ticketed in JIRA (SUP-4621).
   - Third-party pentest: annual by default; can be scheduled quarterly for SOC-heavy pilots with business justification.

4) Disclosure & reporting: we follow a coordinated disclosure policy — we notify impacted customers within 72 hours of confirming exploitation. Public disclosure is coordinated with customers and legal.

If Neurolytics wants the full SOC 2/pen-test under SSPA, please have your legal/security contact send a countersigned SSPA to security@redwood.ai and we’ll expedite sharing. Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the report items or the vendor questionnaire fields in real time.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Information Security | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

References: JIRA SUP-4621, HubSpot NB-7832
Attachments referenced earlier: redacted_pentest_2025.pdf, vuln_process_overview.pdf
